metricsCleanupDesc: Updates the TimescaleDB retention policy to {days} days (system_metrics, disk_metrics)
auditCleanupDesc: Deletes audit entries older than {days} days
metricsCleanupConfirmMsg: The TimescaleDB retention policy will be updated to {days} days. Cleanup will be applied automatically by TimescaleDB.
auditCleanupConfirmMsg: Audit entries older than {days} days will be deleted. This action is irreversible.
metricsRetentionHint: TimescaleDB retention policy for system_metrics and disk_metrics
auditRetentionHint: Audit entries older than this threshold are deleted — applies to any category without a specific value below
categoryDaysHint: Leave empty to use the default value above
recipientHint: Default recipient, used by any alert whose "Recipient(s) email" field is left empty.
